transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Um... mostly just some stuff going on at work. I'm a transportation inspector, and... well, ever since I got this county safety award a while back, things have been off. 

Certain people there have been... twisting my inspection reports. They keep asking these really pointed budget questions. My supervisor keeps saying it’s just a normal review, but... I can tell what's actually happening. They're trying to make me look crooked. It's clearly a coordinated effort to discredit me. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Have you had any direct evidence that your coworkers or supervisor are deliberately trying to frame you?

Like I just said... it's in the reports. You can see how they twist my words. And... the budget questions. They don't ask anyone else those kinds of things. 

My supervisor keeps brushing it off, saying it's just a normal review, but... I'm not stupid. I can tell what they're doing. I don't really know what other evidence you'd need. It's just obvious.
Have you ever heard voices that other people around you could not hear?
No. I don't... I don't hear things. That's not what's happening.
Do you tend to distrust or suspect other people in general, not just at work?
No. Um... not really. Just... just the people at the department. I don't really have issues with anyone else.
Do the people close to you—like family or friends—agree that your coworkers are trying to discredit you?

I don't... I don't really talk to my family about it. It's work stuff. 

They don't do inspections, so they wouldn't really get it anyway. They just know I got that county safety award a while back. But they aren't in the office to see the rest of it... how there's this whole coordinated effort to make me look crooked now. So... I just keep it to myself mostly. I don't really need them to agree.
Before this situation at work, have you usually thought of yourself as especially talented, important, or deserving of special treatment?
No. Um... I don't think so. I just... I just do my job. I'm not looking for special treatment or anything like that. I just want to do my work.
Outside of work, do you usually find yourself suspicious of other people’s motives?
No. Um... I think I said that earlier. It's really just the office. I don't... I don't have any reason to worry about what people outside of work are doing.
Have you generally been this suspicious of people for as long as you can remember?

No, not really. I mean, I never had a reason to be. Like I said, it's just this thing at work. Before all this started with them trying to set me up, I didn't... I didn't go around thinking people were out to get me. It's just the office.
Do you think it is possible that your coworkers are not actually trying to discredit you?

No. I mean... I know what I'm seeing. It all started after I got that county safety award. Ever since then, they've been... they've been twisting my inspection reports. And they keep asking these really pointed questions about the budget, like... like they're trying to make me look crooked or something. My supervisor keeps telling me it's just a normal review, but... I know it's not. I can tell. They're working together to discredit me.
Have you tended to be suspicious or distrustful of people in general for many years, not just since this work situation started?
I... didn't I just answer that? No. Like I said, I'm not... I don't just go around distrusting everyone. It's only because of what's happening at the office.
Have you ever had problems like this with coworkers, supervisors, or other people at other jobs before?
No. Not before this. Just... just here.
Have you ever believed that people were able to control your thoughts or put thoughts into your mind?
No. I... no. That doesn't even make sense. Nobody is controlling my thoughts.
How long have you been feeling that your coworkers are trying to discredit you?
About a year, I guess. It... it started right around the time I got recognized for the county safety initiative. That's when I noticed it.
Outside of this situation at work, would you say you generally find yourself suspicious of other people’s motives?
No. I don't... I'm not really like that. I just keep to myself mostly. It's just... just the situation at work.
Before this started at work, have you always had trouble trusting people in close relationships?
No. I... not really. I trust the people I'm close to. It's never been an issue before.
Have you generally felt suspicious or distrustful of other people since early adulthood?
No. I... no. Like I said, it's just the guys at work. I don't really have a problem with everyone else.
Have you ever felt that strangers or people on TV, radio, or the internet were sending you special messages specifically meant for you?
No. I... no. I don't know why they would. I just watch normal stuff. There's no... messages or anything like that.
Have you had similar suspicions about other people in the past, even before this job, in lots of different settings?
No. Um... I don't think so. Like I said, it's really just... just this job. Before I started here, everything was fine. I didn't have any issues.
How certain are you that your coworkers are trying to discredit you—could you be mistaken, or are you completely sure?

I'm sure. I... I know what I'm seeing. It started after I got that county safety award. Ever since then, they've been... twisting my inspection reports. And they keep asking these pointed questions about the budget, like... like they're trying to make me look crooked or something. My supervisor says it's just normal review, but... I'm not mistaken. I can tell it's a coordinated effort.
